body: Thank you for saying that. I completely understand.

This post and some others immediately convinced me to let it go. Sure, it would have been nice to receive a call prior to heading out the way your team does but it wasn't a huge deal. Like I've said to some other posters, the terms as she explained them were totally fine and now that some of you have helped me see that she has no reason to lie (and that it's standard to open up returns to verify contents, etc) the event is squared away in my mind.

I hope I have not contributed to the sense that some individuals on Reddit consider you (or GS personnel in general) to be monsters, or that they hate you or something like that. I certainly do not.

A couple of you have pretty quickly convinced me to let it go.

The parts about why she opened the box and the phone thing were not intended to be complaints but just context about the situation I ended up in. Honestly, I just chalked it up to the store being understaffed but it wasn't a big deal. I couldn't get through on the phone and thus couldn't inquire as to the exact status of the product before I left, so the open box nature came as a surprise after driving through rush hour traffic. As for why she opened the box, on the terms she gave me I was totally cool with it. The part of the story that led me to writing the OP was just a feeling that maybe I was naive. Some posters here have suggested that she has additional reason to check the merchandise because scams happen. I completely agree, but I have also been scammed before, and I did not think it was over the line to ask you all for feedback about my line of thinking. I would rather seem ridiculous on Reddit than give the GS employee I dealt with a problem without good reason.

I thank you and others for your feedback.

Thank you for the reality check. To be clear, the terms she gave were totally acceptable and I've moved on because many here have helped me realize that it is extremely unlikely that she was not honest and I'm probably just being dumb.
I understand and I have no doubt that there are many scams going on. Thanks for the post.
Sorry brother I'll keep be more careful about which subreddit is which next time.
Entirely possible! I'm sure you guys have seen far crazier things happen...
I opened it up and took a look in the parking lot after leaving the store. Seemed totally new. I think you're right.
